title: Adams the dancer, not a musician; Love and Charity Hall
summary: Interviewer notes Adams never played an instrument but heard bands and danced; he places the Love and Charity Hall uptown.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I was going to ask a little bit. You say you never played any instrument. You're not a musician. Never played. But you did hear a lot of the bands and were dancers, so that's why we wanted to talk to you.

Now, I danced a lot. I used to go to the hall they called the Love and Charity Hall. Where was that, do you remember? The Love and Charity Hall was on camp, I think, right between Valance and some way up in Alabama.
